entities.summary: Sheikha Maitha bint Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum is a karate, taekwondo, polo athlete and Sheikha of Dubai. She represented the United Arab Emirates at the 2008 Summer Olympics, becoming the first female Olympian for her country.
